scope: External standards and recommendation sources. Source/runtime observations have separate evidence JSON and source locators in the workstream reports.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2 quick reference
sources.supports: Accessibility criteria and evaluation scope; automated fixtures are partial evidence.

sources.title: Understanding Bypass Blocks
sources.supports: A bypass mechanism should allow direct access past repeated content; the observed skip interaction needs actual continuation testing.

sources.title: Combobox pattern
sources.supports: Accessible input/popup selection requires coherent roles, focus and active-option state.

sources.title: Disclosure navigation example
sources.supports: Ordinary website navigation can use disclosures without an application menu role.

sources.title: Understanding Animation from Interactions
sources.supports: The cited interaction-animation criterion is AAA, not automatic AA nonconformance.

sources.title: Understanding Target Size Minimum
sources.supports: AA target-size assessment has spacing/inline exceptions; 44px here is a proposed comfort target.

sources.title: Web Interface Guidelines
sources.supports: Heuristic review of semantic controls, focus, motion, typography and asset handling; not a compliance standard.

sources.title: Web Vitals
sources.supports: Field targets: LCP 2.5s, INP 200ms, CLS 0.1 at p75; lab samples do not establish field performance.

sources.title: Optimize Largest Contentful Paint
sources.supports: Identify the LCP resource and loading delays; targeted image delivery improvements should be measured.

sources.title: CSP frame-ancestors
sources.authority_rationale: Primary project or standards documentation; MDN is an established implementation reference.
sources.supports: Framing policy cannot be supplied through a meta CSP element.

sources.title: Headers
sources.supports: Pages _headers per-line limit and combination of matching repeated headers require a host-specific adapter.

sources.title: Upload Pages artifact
sources.supports: Uploader supports named artifacts for deterministic retry selection.

sources.title: Deploy Pages
sources.supports: Deployer artifact_name must match the chosen upload artifact.

sources.title: Previous releases
sources.supports: Node20 EOL and Node24 LTS support the QA runtime refresh proposal.

sources.title: http.server documentation
sources.supports: SimpleHTTPRequestHandler is limited preview tooling and follows symbolic links.

sources.title: Consent implementation guide
sources.supports: Consent defaults precede configuration; advanced mode can emit denied-state pings.

sources.title: Agent Skills specification
sources.supports: A skill is a directory with SKILL.md and optional resources, not inherently one flat Markdown file.

sources.title: Apache License 2.0
sources.supports: Redistribution may require license and notice retention; optional promotional credit is distinct.

sources.title: Localized versions of pages
sources.supports: Alternate language pages require reciprocal, accurate links; draft publication remains a separate editorial policy.
